FIRSTAMENDMENTTOAGENCYLEASEAGREEMENT THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO AGENCY LEASE AGREEMENT(this“First Amendment"), made as of April 1, 2022, and effective as of April 22, 2022 (the “Effective Date"), between NEW YORK CITY INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AGENCY,a corporate governmental agency constituting a body corporate and politic and a public benefit corporation of the State of New York, duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York (the “Agency"), having its principal office at One Liberty Plaza, New York, New York 10006, party of the first part, and 345 PAS HOLDING LLC, a limited liability company duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware (the “Lessee"), having its principal office at 345 Park Avenue South, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10010, supplemental to and amendatory of a certain Agency Lease Agreement, dated as of September 1,2019, between the Agency and the Lessee (the “Original Lease Agreement”, and, together with this First Amendment, assigned to them in the Original LeaseAgreement): WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the New York State Industrial Development Agency Act, constituting Title 1 of Article 18-A of the General Municipal Law,Chapter 24 of the Consolidated Laws of New York, as amended (the “Act"), authorizes and provides for the creation of industrial development agencies in the several counties, cities, villages and towns in the State of New York and empowers such agencies, among other things, to acquire, construct, reconstruct, lease, improve, maintain, equip and furnish land, any building or other improvement, and all real and personal properties, including but not limited to machinery and equipment, deemed necessary in connection therewith, whether or not now in existence or under construction, which shall be suitable for manufacturing, warehousing, research, commercial or industrial purposes, to the end that such agencies may be able to promote, develop, encourage, assist and advance the job opportunities, health, general prosperity and economic welfare of the people of the State of New York and to improve their prosperity and standard of living; and WHEREAS, to accomplish the purposes of the Act, the Agency entered into negotiations with the Lessee for a “project” within the meaning of the Act within the territorial boundaries of the City and located on the Land described in Exhibit A —“Description of the Land"; and WHEREAS, the project consists of the acquisition, renovation, furnishing and equipping of a 12-story commercial facility (the“Facility"), consisting of the acquisition of an approximately 338,222 square foot office building located on an approximately 20,727 square foot parcel of land located at 345 Park Avenue South,New York, New York and the renovation, furnishing and equipping of approximately eleven floors therein, and the subleasing, occupancy, use and operation thereof, all for by various tenants for lab, lab support, office space and other uses applicable to the life sciences industries at the Facility, and having an approximate total project WHEREAS, on September 5, 2019 (the “Commencement Date"), (i) the Lessee leased the Facility to the Agency pursuant to a certain Company Lease Agreement, dated as of September 1,2019, between the Lessee and the Agency, which was recorded on or about 1 4832-3004-0303.8

September 23, 2019 in the Office of the Register of The City of New York, New York County (the“Register's Office") in CRFN 2019000307366, and (i) the Agency subleased its interest in the Facility to the Lessee pursuant to the Original Lease Agreement, which was recorded on or about September 23, 2019 in the Register's Office in CRFN 2019000307367; and WHEREAS, Deerfield Management Company, L.P. ("Deerfield") has guaranteed to the Agency certain payments, obligations, covenants and agreements of the Lessee under the Original Lease Agreement pursuant to a Guaranty Agreement, dated as of September 1, 2019, from Deerfield to the Agency; and WHEREAS, on the Commencement Date, the New York City Economic Development Corporation (*NYCEDC") entered into the Collaboration Agreement with Deerfield, which, among other things, provided for the terms of a sublease to be entered into between the Lessee and Innovation Development Institute Inc. d/b/a MATTER ("MATTER") or a Substitute User Facility (the“MATTERRSF");and WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain acknowledgement dated as of May 27, 2021 (the “Collaboration Residency Acknowledgement"), NYCEDC acknowledged the Collaboration Residency (as defined below) as a Substitute User (as defined in the Original Lease) for purposes of and subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Collaboration Agreement; and WHEREAS, the Lessee has advised the Agency that (i) it desires to establish a collaboration residency (the “Collaboration Residency") consisting of hoteling, conference and educational facilities within the MATTER RSF (comprising the entire 2nd Floor of the Facility Realty),which uses are consistent with the Collaboration Residency Acknowledgement, to be pursuant to a master lease to be entered into between the Lessee and Cure Experience, and (ii) Affiliates of Deerfield will occupy a portion of the MATTER RSF; and WHEREAS, the Original Lease Agreement provides that if prior to the satisfaction of the Leasing Milestones, the Deerfield Entities, collectively, occupy, by agreement or otherwise, in the aggregate more than 49.9% of the Total Improvements RSF, then the amount of RSF in excess of the 49.9% threshold shall be deemed to be Non-Qualified RSF under the Original Lease Agreement; and WHEREAS, the Lessee has requested that the Agency amend the Original Lease Agreement to allow for the actual RSF occupied by Affiliates of Deerfield in the MATTER RSF to be utilized in calculating the aggregate square footage occupied by Affiliates of Deerfield at the Facility instead of 100% of such RSF, provided such occupancy does not exceed 33% of the Collaboration Residency; and WHEREAS,on the Effective Date, (i) the Agency and the Lessee will amend the Original Lease Agreement pursuant to this First Amendment, and (i) NYCEDC and the Lessee will amend the Collaboration Agreement pursuant to a First Amendment to Collaboration Agreement, dated as of the date hereof, between NYCEDC and the Lessee; WHEREAS, the Lessee has requested that the Agency enter into this First Amendment and the Agency, by resolution adopted by the board of directors of the Agency on June 15, 2021, has authorized the entering into of this First Amendment; NOw, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the respective representations and agreements hereinafter contained, the parties hereto agree as follows: Section 1 Definitions. The following defined terms in Section 1.1 of the Original Lease Agreement are hereby amended to read as follows (additional language is underscored and deleted language is in brackets, and the additional terms are added in appropriate alphabetical order): "Substitute User shall mean Cure Experience Services, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company affiliated with Deerfield or another [an] Entity designated by the Agency and determined by the Agency to be qualified to manage a life science incubator, accelerator and/or educational programming." Section 2Section 8.9(c)(i) of the Original Lease Agreement is hereby amended as follows (additional language is underscored and deleted language is in brackets): "(i)By the Substantial Completion Outside Date, the Lessee shall offer to (a) Innovation Development Institute Inc. d/b/a MATTER ("MATTER") or a Substitute User, on terms approved by NYCEDC, a lease for a premises totaling no less than one (1) floor of Lab the execution of such lease (the “MATTER RSF"), and (b) Yeda Research and Development. Company ("YEDA") no less than 6,300 RSF of Lab Ready Space (collectively, the “First Leasing Milestone").Should MATTER orYeda fail to execute and deliver a Qualified Lease with the Lessee by the Substantial Completion Outside Date, such failure shall not constitute an Event of Default by the Lessee hereunder provided: (1)  Each proposed Tenant Lease to MATTER and Yeda was offered and negotiated by the Lessee ingood faith, and (2)If MATTER does not execute a Tenant Lease or MATTER executes a Tenant Lease and such lease expires or terminates before the end of theTerm, then the Lessee shall reserve the MATTERRSFforleasetoaSubstituteUserinaccordancewiththeterms andconditionssetforth in the CollaborationAgreement." Section3 Section 8.9(d) of the Original Lease Agreement is hereby amended and restatedasfollows: "(d) The Lessee agrees that (i) if prior to the satisfaction of the Leasing Milestones, the Deerfield Entities, collectively, occupy, by agreement or otherwise, in the aggregate more than 49.9% of the Total Improvements RSF, then the amount of RSF in excess of the 49.9% threshold shall be deemed tobeNon-Qualified RSF under thisAgreement (regardless of whether suchspace is occupied for a Life Science Use), and (ii) following the satisfaction of the Leasing Milestones, if (a) Deerfield or any Affiliate of Deerfield, collectively, occupy, by agreement or otherwise, in the aggregate more than 49.9% of the Total Improvements RSF, or (b) Deerfield, any Affiliate of Deerfield, or any Entity that is not an Affiliate of Deerfield but in which Deerfield or any Affiliate 3 4832-3004-0303.8

of Deerfield has a beneficial ownership interest of more than 25%, collectively occupy,by agreement or otherwise, in the aggregate more than 62% of the Total Improvements RSF, then the amount of RSF in excess of the applicable percentage threshold shall be deemed to beNon- QualifiedRSFunder thisAgreement(regardless ofwhether suchspaceis occupiedfor aLife Science Use). The determination of whether (x) an Entity is an Affiliate of Deerfield or (y) Deerfield has a beneficial ownership interest in an Entity, shall be made at the time that such RSF, or in the absence of such an agreement, commences occupancy of such space, taking into account for purposes of such determination any agreement then in effect between Deerfield or its Affiliate and such Entity to acquire a beneficial ownership interest in or Control of such Entity at a later date, unless such transaction is ultimately not completed. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the following shall not count towards the applicable threshold RSF percentages above: (i)  RSF (other than the MATTER RSF) that a Deerfield Entity master leases for sublease to Entities that are not Deerfield Entities (provided that no Deerfield Entity occupies such RSF); (i)the MATTER RSF occupied by an Affiliate of Deerfield provided suchRSFdoes not exceed33%oftheMATTERRSF.If anAffiliateof Deerfieldoccupies more than33%oftheMATTERRSF,100%oftheMATTERRSFshallcount towards the applicable threshold RSF percentage in subsection (d) of this Section 8.9; and (i)Up to one (1) floor of the Total Improvements RSF of Life Science Use Convening Space." Section 4 Section 11.5 of the Original Lease Agreement is hereby amended and restated as follows: "Section 11.5 Notices. All notices, certificates or other communications hereunder shall be sufficient if sent (i) by registered or certified United States mail, return receipt requested and postage prepaid, (i) by a nationally recognized overnight delivery service for overnight delivery, charges prepaid or (i) by hand delivery, addressed, as follows: (1) if to the Agency, to New York City Industrial Development Agency One Liberty Plaza 165Broadway New York, New York 10006 Attention:General Counsel(with a copy to theExecutiveDirector of the Agency at the same address) (2) if to the Lessee or Deerfield 345 PAS Holding LLC c/o Deerfield Management Company, L.P. 345ParkAvenueSouth,12thFloor New York, New York 10010 Attention: President 4 4832-3004-0303.8
